verdict.rationale: Temporal's own docs advertise 'Tools for agents' and a hosted MCP server (temporal.mcp.kapa.ai) that a runtime probe confirmed is live and auth-gated (401 with OAuth challenge), showing a genuine official MCP endpoint agents can connect to. However, this appears scoped to documentation/knowledge assistance rather than exposing Temporal's core workflow/activity orchestration primitives as MCP tools, and there's no first-party doc page explicitly walking through MCP server setup or tool schemas beyond the llms.txt mention. Missing for 10: dedicated MCP server documentation page, evidence of MCP exposing workflow-control operations (not just docs), independent/community confirmation of usage.
